title: Grateful Dead Live at Starlight Theater on 1982-08-03
source: Aud -> AKG CE1s -> Uher CR240 cassette -> Uher Royal Deluxe 7.5 ips -> Korg MR1000 @24/96 -> AudioGate -> flac level 8; Recorded by Jimi, transferred to digital by CR. AudioGate was used for tracking only.

ai_review.summary: Outstanding analog recording of a great show, with warm tape sound and only a slight pitch slowdown.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the performance, calling it an excellent show that somehow slipped under the radar. The UHER‑derived audience tape is praised for its rich analog warmth despite being half a step slow, making it a highly enjoyable listen.

ai_rating.rationale: Two very positive reviews (5★ and 4★) highlight both an excellent performance and high‑quality analog recording, with only a minor pitch issue noted.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Warm tape sound praised as 'analog goodness in the extreme'; slight half‑step slowdown noted but does not detract from overall clarity.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewers describe the concert as a consistently strong show that "slipped below the radar" despite its quality, implying solid pacing and flow throughout.
